Commercial scope (summary): handle a lot of day-to-day operations, sourcing beans, staffing help, and social media This agreement governs the parties’ joint ownership and operation of a mobile coffee cart business. User owns the trailer/cart setup, espresso machine, grinder, generator, and most startup equipment at signing, and those assets remain identified as the starting business property unless later transferred in writing. party_b will handle day-to-day operations, bean sourcing, staffing help, and social media, while both parties will share responsibility for the business as set out in the final agreement. The agreement should define how future cash contributions are approved, how inventory is purchased, who controls bookkeeping and bank access, what spending requires consent, how reimbursements are handled, how profits are calculated and distributed, and how taxes are reported. It should also cover ownership and permitted use of the brand name and social media accounts, confidentiality of business information, limits on side businesses that take customers, and practical rules for illness, disability, death
